g.text: Reason Commons helps you make progress on something that matters, one small loop at a
Who should ask you the questions?
You can change this any time: Settings on the home screen, or Ctrl+P
inside a goal. Your goals keep going from where they are when you switch.

Asks the loop's questions in order and keeps your exact words. No
advice, no trees. The best way to do a first loop.
